steps.title: Extract viral RNA
steps.instruction: Extract RNA from each sample using the QIAamp Viral RNA Mini kit (Catalog #52904) following the manufacturer’s instructions.

steps.title: Assess viral load by RT‑PCR
steps.instruction: Perform CDC 2009 real‑time RT‑PCR on all extracts, record the cycle‑threshold (Ct) values and retain only samples with Ct < 32 for optimal downstream results.

steps.title: AMPure XP bead cleanup of RNA
steps.instruction: Clean up the RNA with AMPure XP beads (Beckman Coulter Catalog #AXP) using absolute ethanol (Avantor Catalog #89125-176, CAS 64‑17‑5) and nuclease‑free water (Thermo Fisher Catalog #AM9932).

substeps.instruction: Bring AMPure XP beads to room temperature and shake the bottle to resuspend particles.
Add 1.8× volume of AMPure XP reagent to each sample.
Pipette‑mix the mixture 10 times.
Incubate 5 min at room temperature.
Place the plate on a SPRIPlate 96R Ring Super Magnet for 2 min; allow beads to separate.
Remove all supernatant, then add 200 µL of 80 % ethanol to each well, incubate 30 s at room temperature, and discard the ethanol. Repeat the ethanol wash once more (total two washes).
Air‑dry the beads briefly, avoiding over‑drying (cracked bead ring).
Add 52 µL RNase/DNase‑free water as elution buffer, pipette‑mix 10 times, and incubate 2 min.
Place the plate on the magnet for 1 min, then transfer 50 µL of eluate to a new plate.

steps.title: Add TSB and incubate
steps.instruction: To each well add 10 µL TSB, pipette up and down 10 times with a multichannel pipette, reseal with an adhesive PCR plate seal, incubate at 37 °C (time not specified) followed by a hold at 10 °C (duration not specified).

steps.title: Prepare beads with TWB washes
steps.instruction: Thaw the EPM on ice, then perform magnetic bead washes with TWB as described.

substeps.instruction: Remove the plate seal, quick‑spin the plate, and discard the seal.
Place the plate on a magnetic stand until the solution is clear.
Using a multichannel pipette, remove and discard the supernatant.
Add TWB (volume not specified) directly to the pellet, pipette gently to resuspend without creating foam.
Place the plate on the magnet until the solution is clear; discard supernatant.
Repeat the TWB addition, resuspension, magnetic separation, and supernatant removal once more.
Add TWB, incubate on the magnet for 00:03:00 (3 min) or until clear, then discard supernatant.
Add 100 µL TWB directly to the pellet, resuspend gently, place on the magnet, and avoid overdrying. Keep the plate on the magnet until ready for the next step.

steps.title: Tagmentation reaction setup
steps.instruction: Prepare the tagmentation mix and combine with the eluated sample.

substeps.instruction: In a new 96‑well PCR plate, mix 11 µL BLT (Bead‑Linked Transposomes) with 11 µL TB1 (Tagmentation Buffer 1) to obtain a 20 µL tagmentation mix.
Add the 20 µL mix to 30 µL of the previously eluated sample.
Pipette up and down 10 times to mix.
Seal the plate with a Microseal ‘B’ adhesive seal.
Centrifuge the plate gently to collect liquid at the bottom of the wells.
Incubate 37 °C for 15 min, then hold at 10 °C (time not specified).

steps.title: Amplify and index libraries
steps.instruction: Perform PCR amplification and add Illumina UD indexes.

substeps.instruction: Vortex the EPM to mix and briefly centrifuge.
Add 22 µL EPM and 22 µL nuclease‑free water to each well.
Remove and discard any remaining TWB, avoiding overdrying.
Add 40 µL EPM mix to the beads.
Add 10 µL Illumina UD Index (Set A‑D, Catalog #20091654, #20091656, #20091658).
Run PCR using the recommended conditions (conditions not detailed in the source).

steps.title: Quantify libraries with Qubit
steps.instruction: Measure DNA concentration of each library using the Qubit dsDNA High Sensitivity kit according to the SOP “DNA Quantification using the Qubit Fluorometer”.

steps.title: TURBO DNase digestion
steps.instruction: Digest RNA with TURBO DNase (2 U/µL, Fisher Scientific Catalog #AM2239).

substeps.instruction: Prepare a master mix per sample: 1 µL TURBO DNase (2 U), 5 µL TURBO DNase Buffer, and 14 µL nuclease‑free water (total 20 µL).
Add the master mix to up to 10 µg RNA in a 50 µL reaction.
Incubate 37 °C for 30 min.

steps.title: Library cleanup on magnetic stand
steps.instruction: Perform bead‑based cleanup of amplified libraries.

substeps.instruction: Centrifuge the plate at 280 × g for 1 min to collect contents at the bottom of the wells.
Place the plate on a magnetic stand and wait ~5 min until the liquid is clear.
Transfer 45 µL supernatant from each well to a new PCR plate.
Resuspend the beads (IPB) by adding 40 µL nuclease‑free water to each well containing supernatant.
Add 45 µL IPB to each well and pipette 10 times to mix.
Seal the plate and incubate at room temperature for 5 min.
Place on the magnetic stand again and wait ~5 min until clear.
Add 15 µL of IPB to each well of a new “MIDI” plate.
Transfer 125 µL supernatant from each original well into the corresponding MIDI well containing the 15 µL IPB.
Incubate the sealed MIDI plate at room temperature for 5 min.
Place on the magnetic stand and wait ~5 min until clear.
Without disturbing the beads, remove and discard the supernatant.
Wash beads: add 200 µL fresh 80 % ethanol (no mixing), incubate 30 s, then discard supernatant.
Repeat the ethanol wash a second time.
Using a 20 µL pipette, remove any residual ethanol.
Air‑dry the beads on the magnetic stand for 5 min.
Remove the plate from the magnet and add 32 µL RSB to the beads.
Pipette to resuspend, incubate at room temperature for 2 min.
Place the plate on the magnetic stand and wait ~2 min until clear.
Transfer 30 µL supernatant to a new 96‑well PCR plate.

steps.title: Optional safe stopping point
steps.instruction: If pausing the workflow, seal the plate with a Microseal ‘B’ adhesive seal or a Microseal ‘F’ foil seal and store at –25 °C to –15 °C for up to 30 days.

steps.title: Pool and dilute libraries
steps.instruction: Combine 5–10 µL of each library into a single pool and dilute the pooled libraries according to Illumina’s denature‑and‑dilute protocol.
